input_binding: input_id is the SHA-256 of the exact Image.gz, serviceability DTB, foundation initramfs, userspace SHA256SUMS, credential public/host files and published initramfs source digests; it is substituted into both markers and candidate.json
admission_binding: private admission pins the exact clean pushed source commit, candidate and deployment receipt, predecessor, executor, classifier, candidate validator, deployment parser, session packet, base collector, recovery host pin, candidate host pin and administrator public key; custodian exclusivity and one observation are explicit
